name: Ab Roller (Ab Rocket / Ab Lounge style)

lead: Ab rollers and chair-style devices such as the Ab Lounge and Ab Rocket guide a seated or reclined crunch motion. They are marketed for a flatter, firmer-looking midsection by training the abdominal muscles with less neck and back strain.

The published studies are electromyography comparisons. In a 22-person study, the upper rectus abdominis showed significantly higher activity in a traditional crunch than in the Ab Lounge jackknife [1]. A summary of EMG rankings puts the ab rocker at 21% of the crunch for rectus abdominis [2].

paras: Users sit or recline in the device and perform repeated crunch-like movements as part of a home ab routine, often alongside diet changes for fat loss. Muscle endurance gains are what the device itself targets.
Risks are low overall. Crunch-style movements can strain the lower back if overused, according to the abdominal exercise summary [2].

chain: Firmer midsection, more visible with lower body fat
angle.text: The devices train the abdominal muscles through a supported crunch. Visible definition also depends on body fat, which changes with overall diet and activity.

lead: Ab Roller-style gadgets, including the Ab Rocket and Ab Lounge, are home abdominal devices sold through infomercials as a way to a flatter-looking stomach. They give the user support and a guided path for a crunch or jackknife motion.

An EMG study of 22 students compared a traditional crunch with the Ab Lounge jackknife; the upper rectus abdominis was significantly more active in the traditional crunch [1]. A compilation of EMG results ranks the ab rocker lowest for rectus abdominis (21% of a crunch) and obliques (74%), while noting that longer, lower-intensity sessions can still be beneficial [2].

How abs look also depends on fat over the muscle. The spot reduction idea, that working a muscle burns the fat above it, is regarded by physiologists as disproven; a randomized study of 24 adults found that six weeks of abdominal exercise did not shrink subcutaneous abdominal fat, though core endurance improved [3].
infobox: Ab Rocket, Ab Lounge, ab rocker

paras: Chair- or cradle-style ab devices let the user lie back and crunch against a support. Wikipedia's abdominal exercise page lists the ab roller and Ab Rocket Twister among gadgets and machines used for this purpose [2].

In the Ab Lounge study, upper rectus abdominis activity was significantly higher during a traditional crunch than during the device's basic jackknife [1]. The Ab Lounge had been promoted as being as effective as a crunch [1].

In a compiled EMG ranking relative to the traditional crunch, the ab rocker scored 21% for rectus abdominis, versus 248% for the bicycle crunch and 212% for the captain's chair [2]. The same source notes that a low-activity exercise done for longer can match a high-activity one in benefit [2].

One randomized, comparative EMG study of the Ab Lounge exists [1]. For abdominal exercise generally, a randomized trial of 24 adults found no reduction in subcutaneous abdominal fat after six weeks, with improved sit-up endurance [3].
Experts quoted on crunch-based exercise warn that overuse can strain the lower back, and suggest dead bugs and planks as alternatives [2].
